purpose: Teach: （株）/小生/亭/竹中/ニッポン放送/世田谷/キャピタル/人組

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約書、当社（株）小川商会との提携、最終版を回そう。
lines.en: Let's circulate the contract—the final version for our partnership with K.K. Ogawa-Shokai.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient delivery. Business-like authority without harshness. Clear enunciation on the partnership terms. Slight forward momentum, as if moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。小生、ドラフトを準備しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've got the draft ready.
lines.style: Prompt, assured. No hesitation—the work is already done. Warm efficiency. Light confidence in the voice, not defensive.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 記念会食は、九段亭で開く。
lines.en: The celebratory dinner will be at Kudan-tei.
lines.style: Decisive, matter-of-fact. Sets the detail as a given, not a suggestion. Calm and authoritative. Minimal inflection—this is settled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 広報、竹中担当、ニッポン放送系メディアを当てます。
lines.en: PR is Takenaka's lead—we're targeting Nippon-Hoso media outlets.
lines.style: Brisk strategic update. Clipped pacing. Each assignment lands cleanly. Professional, no elaboration. The tone of someone distributing work that's already been thought through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 世田谷支店も、キャピタル提携先として、3人組の幹部で対応。
lines.en: The Setagaya branch will handle the capital partner side with a three-person executive team.
lines.style: Concluding statement, slightly lower cadence. Deliberate and thorough. The final piece settling into place. Steady eye-level delivery, closing this round of briefing.
